The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, tools, supervision, and other items and services necessary to ensure that grounds maintenance is performed at Facility, Cheboygan MI in a manner that will maintain healthy grass, trees, shrubs, and plants and present a clean, neat, and professional appearance. The Contractor’s work force shall perform all services associated with general grounds maintenance duties. This will include all management and preventative maintenance actions in addition to the specific tasks addressed in this section. The Contractor shall take precautions to prevent scalping (cut below 1 inch which can cause dead grass), uneven mowing, and cutting by equipment and damage to trees and shrubs. The Contractor shall repair damaged turf and replace shrubs and trees damaged during mowing operations. 3.1.4 Hours of operation. The Contractor shall perform the work between the hours of 8:00am and 5:00pm, local time, Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays. 3.2 Grounds maintenance plan and work plan report. The Contractor shall maintain a grounds maintenance plan that provides the overall approach to ensure scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities are accomplished in a man

n a standard grass catcher or removed immediately after cutting. Weed-eaters shall not be used for cutting operations, but may be used for trimming only. If any bare ground becomes populated with grass, weeds, or sand through natural spread, i.e. not artificially planted, maintain such area(s) as a part of the basic contract. 3.3.3 Remove all rubbish, debris, trash, rocks, fallen fruits, leaves, portable objects, etc., from all areas, including surfaced areas such as sidewalks, parking lots, driveways, and roadways after cutting. Remove all debris and trash lodged in or under shrubs, hedges, fences, and along foundation walls. Use caution to prevent power equipment from damaging trees and shrubs. Damaged property shall be replaced at the Contractor’s expense. Remove all portable items such as trash containers, athletic equipment, etc., when they interfere with the grass cutting effort, and return them to their original locations upon completion of the cutting effort 3.4 Areas excluded from lawn maintenance. The Contractor shall use all metal or other approved material, watertight, completely enclosed “packer” type bodies that are designed and manufactured for the collection of garbage and are capable of servicing detachable containers.
